integrity: The proofs are analytical; finite reproducibility computations are corroborative. Scientific originality is an evidence-based same-model assessment and not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite simple undirected graphs, at least three states, and strict local successor-majority thresholds. It does not decide the Moore borderline threshold four, infinite graphs or the optimal Moore stabilization constant. Historical priority relative to an inaccessible 1997 full paper is not established.
title: A strict-majority Lyapunov law for cyclic graph automata
